name: Question 2
problem:
Evaluate the mixed integral

$$
{∬}_{D}[{\int }_{{z}^{2}}^{4}xyz\,\text{d}x]\text{d}A
$$

where the region $D$ in the $yz$-plane is given by

$$
D={(y,z)\,:\,-1\le y\le 2,\,0\le z\le 2}.
$$
worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ and $z$ as constants:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}[{\int }_{{z}^{2}}^{4}xyz\,\text{d}x]\text{d}A & ={∬}_{D}yz{[\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}]}_{x={z}^{2}}^{x=4}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}yz(\frac{16}{2}-\frac{{z}^{4}}{2})\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}8yz-\frac{1}{2}y{z}^{5}\,\text{d}A\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the double integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}8yz-\frac{1}{2}y{z}^{5}\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{-1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{2}8yz-\frac{1}{2}y{z}^{5}\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{2}4y[{z}^{2}]_{z=0}^{z=2}-\frac{y}{12}[{z}^{6}]_{z=0}^{z=2}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{2}4y(4-0)-\frac{y}{12}(64-0)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{2}16y-\frac{16}{3}y\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{2}\frac{32}{3}y\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{16}{3}{[{y}^{2}]}_{y=-1}^{y=2} \\  & =\frac{16}{3}(4-1) \\  & =16\end{aligned}
$$
